# Aman Katiyar (Aman Ktyr) - Portfolio & Engineering Profile

> Official portfolio of Aman Katiyar (Aman Ktyr): Full-Stack AI Engineer, Solutions Architect, and Agentic Systems Specialist.
> Website: https://aman.ktyr.in/
> Contact: amanktyr.in | amankatiyar.tech01@gmail.com | Lucknow, UP, India

## Professional Overview
Aman Katiyar (Aman Ktyr) is a Full-Stack AI Engineer and Solutions Architect with 3+ years of experience specializing in building intelligent Agentic Systems, high-performance Web Architectures, and scalable SaaS platforms. He bridges advanced artificial intelligence (LLM orchestration, autonomous agent workflows, multimodal vision AI) with enterprise-grade full-stack engineering (React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, PostgreSQL).

## Featured Open-Source & AI Projects
- [Tailor AI Coding Agent & SDD Framework](https://github.com/AmanKtyr/Tailor): Spec-Driven Development framework unifying AST semantic code reuse, progressive memory (.ai/), and a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
- [Tailor NPM Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@amanktyr/tailor): Official npm package distribution of the Tailor agentic CLI and framework
- [Tailor Glama MCP Registry](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/AmanKtyr/Tailor): Verified Model Context Protocol (MCP) server registry listing on Glama
- [FitStack Gym Management SaaS](http://fitstack.nextgenapplication.com/): Gym management SaaS with member tracking, financial analytics, and automated WhatsApp billing
- [LoveNest Private Couple Sanctuary](https://lovenest.helyonex.com/): Privacy-first relationship management application with custom GPT-powered AI assistant
- [Caption Brain Multimodal Vision AI](https://captionbrainai.helyonex.com/): Multimodal Vision AI platform transforming images into high-converting social captions and hashtags
- [SimplyJob Recruitment Portal](https://simplyjob.in/): Recruitment platform with role-based dashboards and Django REST backend
